basic_details.short_information: Women Development & Child Welfare Department, Hyderabad District has released the Hyderabad Anganwadi Teacher Recruitment 2026 notification for filling 181 Anganwadi Teacher (AWT) vacancies under various ICDS Projects. Interested candidates can apply for these Anganwadi Teacher posts from 29 July 2026 to 22 August 2026 as per the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Hyderabad Anganwadi Teacher Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: A total of 181 Anganwadi Teacher vacancies are available under five ICDS projects of Hyderabad District. The notification specifies the project-wise distribution of Anganwadi Teacher vacancies, with the highest number of vacancies in ICDS Secunderabad followed by Charminar, Nampally, Golconda, and Khairthabad projects.

content_sections.heading: Hyderabad Anganwadi Teacher Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
Hyderabad Anganwadi Teacher Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for Hyderabad Anganwadi Teacher Recruitment 2026 must fulfil the eligibility conditions mentioned in the official notification. The applicant shall have passed Intermediate (10+2). The candidate shall be 18 years to 35 years of age as on 01.07.2026. Only women candidates are eligible to apply.

content_sections.heading: Hyderabad Anganwadi Teacher Selection Process
content_sections.text: Candidates will be selected according to the guidelines issued by the Women Development & Child Welfare Department for Anganwadi appointments.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for Hyderabad Anganwadi Teacher Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates need to submit scanned copies of relevant certificates/documents as mentioned in the notification. SSC Certificate Caste Certificate (if applicable) Educational Qualification Certificate Residence Certificate Other required supporting documents mentioned in the notification The notification lists required document copies and certificate verification requirements for applicants.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Hyderabad Anganwadi Teacher Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Check the official Hyderabad Anganwadi Teacher notification carefully. Download and prepare the required application documents. Submit the application along with necessary certificates as instructed. Attend certificate verification if shortlisted.
